title: Unit 25 Consolidation: Separation of Powers and the Order of Norms
goal: I can use the words for norms, the powers of the state and checks and balances.
I can use *köteles*, a participle before the noun, *viszont* and *céljából* when I write about the state.
I can grade a judgement with a degree adverb and say what the text about Eötvös József warns against.
